props.subtitle: A live motion plays behind your real HTML headline, and pauses off screen.
props.featureBody: Under two live players per screen, a still frame for reduced motion.

scenes.say: On React and Next.js sites, MotionBackground puts a live motion behind your real HTML, and it pauses off screen.
On any HTML page or WordPress site, it is one script tag and an opus motion element.
Video editors and apps get exported files with alpha, or call the HTTP render API.

props.prompt: Make a ten second launch intro: aurora, a neon title, a little sparkle.
props.answer:
Searched the library with **search_motions**, then layered `aurora` + `neon-sign` + `embers`.

Previewed three frames, fixed the title contrast, and rendered **launch-intro.mp4**.

scenes.say: And AI agents can search, preview and render every motion themselves, through the built in MCP server.
That is the whole library. Every one of the 616 motions, all connected.
